movement.title: BL2 Eternal
movement.desc: Doom Eternal, but it's BL2. Adds in-air dashing and glory kills for critically low health enemies.

movement.title: Movement Tech
movement.desc: Adds double jumps, slams and grappling. There are configurable settings for the slams and grappling. Grappling is disabled in coop.

movement.title: Sliding
movement.desc: *Adds sliding to BL2/TPS/AoDK.* Pressing crouch while sprinting will make you slide. If you jump while sliding, you will jump keep the momentum, which generally makes you go further. Sliding down slopes will accelerate you, while sliding up slopes will slow you down.

movement.title: Speed
movement.desc: Makes sprinting faster, leaving normal walking speed untouched.

movement.title: Sprint Adjuster
movement.desc: Change speed when sprinting, while preserving normal speed when not sprinting. Optionally set Air Control to allow better control in the air with the movement keys, to have a better chance of stopping yourself from flinging off a cliff for instance. Configurable keybinding to allow turning on and off on the fly.

movement.title: Sprint Set-and-Forget
movement.desc: This mod remembers your movement mode (sprinting or walking): if you were sprinting the last time you moved, you will automatically start sprinting the next time you move. Pressing the Sprint key will switch back and forth between sprinting and walking at any time. There is a setting in Mod Options that controls whether you start out sprinting or walking when the game begins.

movement.title: TPS Style Bunny Hop
movement.desc: Lets you bunny hop like you can in Pre-Sequel.

movement.title: speedometer
movement.desc: Gotta go fast! Shows your current speed in km/h or mph.

ui.title: Action Skill Countdown Timer
ui.desc: When your action skill ends, a timer will start on your hud. The timer is fairly customizable, you can change its color, position, size and font. Note: The timer is more based on your action skill cooldown rate more than actual seconds. Thanks to ZetaDaemon for the farm counter, which made this possible.

ui.title: Better Damage Feedback
ui.desc: Allows for the customisation of damage particles changing the colour, colour on crit, toggle CRITICAL effect, increased size on crit or turn damage numbers off entirely. Additionally allows for hit sounds and critical hit sounds.

ui.title: Better Third Person
ui.desc: Improves the functionality of third person with camera customisation. Third person aim has a couple options, zoom in while remaining third person, scope in like normal or default zoom in but double click to zoom. Also fixes third person weapon aim, this may cause performance issues so it can be...

ui.title: Better UI Controls
ui.desc: This mod will let you use your movement keys (in my case WASD) to control a bunch of menus. It also enables your Use key (in my case E) to select items in menus. The mod will automatically adjust to your keys.

ui.title: Big Particle Party
ui.desc: Have you ever felt like the games particles is lacking a bit of oomph? Big PP allows you to increase the amount of various particles. Check out the various particle types in the mod options. Using Big PP might decrease your performance, depending on your GPU and your game settings.

ui.title: Bossbar
ui.desc: Adds a Boss-/Health-bar to most named enemies.

ui.title: ChatLog
ui.desc: Logs received chat messages to the SDK console. On BL1/BL1E, also lets you extend how long chat stays on screen.

ui.title: ConfigurableViewModel (CVM)
ui.desc: A mod that allows you to change the viewmodel of any WeaponType. To change your viewmodel go ingame, Escape->Mods->CVM

ui.title: Consistent Time
ui.desc: Keeps a consistent Day/Night cycle by stopping maps from setting specific times. Also includes an option to force the time to stay at a specific time.

ui.title: Custom Skins
ui.desc: A simple mod allowing you to have custom character skins, all selectable! Hit R in the mod menu to reload your skins Press O to open your skin folder Toggle skins in the Options menu, sorted by character

ui.title: Hide Undiscovered Missions
ui.desc: Hides undiscoved missions in the mission log.

ui.title: Item Lights
ui.desc: Adds lights to items.

ui.title: Jump To Level Challenges
ui.desc: Adds a keybind to the Challenges menu to jump to the current level's challenges, and an option to hide completed challenges.

ui.title: LootMarker
ui.desc: Places a marker on the map and minimap for every legendary or better. Currently supports Exodus and UPC/Vanilla for both, TPS and BL2. You can change the marker type, optionally enable a sound (and choose out of a predefined list) to be played when a legendary got dropped.

ui.title: No Ads
ui.desc: Prevents ads from showing. Includes both the obnoxious banner ads as well as the small MoTD DLC ads.

ui.title: No Main Menu Rotation
ui.desc: Disable the rotation in the main menu, for peoples with vertigo.

ui.title: No Texture Fade
ui.desc: Disables texture fading on game start, forcing textures to load at thier highest level.

ui.title: NoCrosshair
ui.desc: Disables your Crosshair. If you have the coroutines and canvaslib libraries installed, you may enable a static square crosshair in the center of the screen. This static square can further be customized in the mods settings menu.

ui.title: Offline Helpers
ui.desc: Adds a few small features useful when playing offline.

ui.title: Paintball
ui.desc: Replaces the boring decals with paintball splats!

ui.title: Photo Mode
ui.desc: Simple Photo Mode. 'Mousewheel Up/Down' to change the active modifier. Hold 'Shift' while scrolling to change the camera movement speed. Hold 'R' while scrolling to change the camera rotation. Hold 'F' while scrolling to change the camera FOV.

ui.title: Ping!
ui.desc: Ping the world! Allows you to ping various objects and locations to communicate with other players. Every player needs to have this mod installed to be able to receive pings.

ui.title: PizzaForFastball
ui.desc: Replaces the Fastballs mesh with the one of a Pizza.

ui.title: Python Part Notifier
ui.desc: Shows the parts making up all of your items and weapons on their cards. Yes this even includes Grenades, COMs, and Relics/Oz Kits. Has full mod support, so if a mod adds extra parts to a weapon or changes a part’s mesh it will properly update. Unique part support is limited, they may just show the same as the base part with the same mesh.

ui.title: Run Counter
ui.desc: A Mod that tracks save quits and item drops of at least legendary rarity. Chat command control with .rc prefix allows you to create new tracked farms, load previously made farms and control what data is shown where at any given time. If you are looking for something to make obs overlays check out ZetaDæmon’s Farm Counter

ui.title: Shield Recharge Timer
ui.desc: Displays a configurable timer on your HUD that counts the seconds before your shield starts to recharge

ui.title: Simple Chinese Fix
ui.desc: Fix several inexplicably invalid Simple Chinese Language localization words. Lyuda = 鲁达 Minds Eye Skill = 灵犀之眼

ui.title: SimpleZoom
ui.desc: Adds a keybind that allows you to zoom.

ui.title: Super Screenshots
ui.desc: High resolution screenshots independent of game resolution, 1440p - 16k

ui.title: TPS SkinFix
ui.desc: Allows the exec and set command for MaterialInstanceConstant Objects. This allows the editing of Skins in TPS. Simply place this mod inside your TPS Mods folder, no enabling of this mod needed.

ui.title: Time of Day Changer
ui.desc: Allows changing the current in-game time of day either to day, night, or forward in a fixed increment using hotkeys.

ui.title: Uber Post Processing
ui.desc: Exposes many post processing effects to the user. It allows you to easily change the color of any scene. Furthermore you can change settings related to Depth of Field, Bloom, Motion Blur and many other effects. For this mod to work correctly, please ensure that you enabled the Depth of Field in your settings.

ui.title: Widescreen Fog Fix
ui.desc: Keeps the fog, haze and atmosphere at any field of view on ultrawide and super ultrawide screens.

ui.title: speedometer
ui.desc: Gotta go fast! Shows your current speed in km/h or mph.

utility.title: All My Homies Hate SHiFT
utility.desc: Sets offline/lan mode on boot to speed up starting the game a lil bit

utility.title: Alt Use Catch-a-Ride
utility.desc: Adds alt use binds to Catch-a-Ride stations, to instantly deploy a vehicle. Options to teleport to vehicle on spawn, choose a vehicle family (including DLC vehicles), and choose the vehicle weapon to use for each family.

utility.title: Alt Use Fast Travel
utility.desc: This mod enables alt use for fast travel stations that will travel you to either your current objective, the station you last traveled from, or a specific station.

utility.title: Alt Use Vendors
utility.desc: Adds alt use binds to vendors to let you quickly refill health and ammo and sell trash, like in BL3/Wonderlands.

utility.title: AutoSave Blocker
utility.desc: F2 to toggle Displays text indicator of current status, as well as an HUD message when a save is attempted but blocked.

utility.title: Badass Rank Lock
utility.desc: Prevents badass rank increasing, and non-level-specific challenge reward pop-ups from showing. Intended for use with mods that would otherwise give you loads of rank.

utility.title: Bank & Stash Anywhere (BASA)
utility.desc: Use the bank and stash from anywhere with a hotkey. Can cause some visual texture issues

utility.title: BankManager
utility.desc: Customize the size of your character’s backpack on the fly!

utility.title: Better Spawns and Better Travel (BSABT)
utility.desc: Ports back some qol features of BL3: open the fast travel from anywhere teleport in your vehicle from the map menu spawn at the last triggered spawn station

utility.title: Better UI Controls
utility.desc: This mod will let you use your movement keys (in my case WASD) to control a bunch of menus. It also enables your Use key (in my case E) to select items in menus. The mod will automatically adjust to your keys.

utility.title: Co-op Save Quit
utility.desc: press f5 to reload the map. chests, vendors and enemies reset the same as a save quit would, but nobody gets kicked out of your game. only the host presses the key. everyone gets pulled along and lands back where they were stood, not at the fast travel point.

utility.title: Controller Binds
utility.desc: Adds controller combo binds for any mod keybinds, plus a menu button for the mod menu. All controller binds are set in this mod's keybind options.

utility.title: Coop Pause
utility.desc: Allow all players in a coop session to open the pause menu to fully pause the game until someone closes the menu.

utility.title: Custom Scoped Sensitivity
utility.desc: Adds custom ADS sensitivity multiplier sliders for each sniper sight.

utility.title: Decent Console
utility.desc: My attempt at improving the ingame console by adding: - ctrl+backspace to delete the last word - ctrl+delete to delete the next word - ctrl+left/right to move the cursor by word - auto-completion for commands by pressing tab - switch between suggestions or history with up/down - suggestions will show...

utility.title: Dialog Skipper
utility.desc: Skips dialog automatically.

utility.title: Dual Binds
utility.desc: This mod will allow you to have keys do multiple things. I highly suggest you read the readme and check out the example ini on github.

utility.title: Easy Read Only
utility.desc: Toggle Read Only on a button press

utility.title: Emotes
utility.desc: Adds a list of different emotes. Check Modded Keybinds to configure the mod.

utility.title: End Action Skill Key
utility.desc: Adds a hotkey to force end your action skill. Most useful on Krieg and Sal.

utility.title: Equip Locker
utility.desc: Adds various options that prevent you from equipping certain types of items/weapons.

utility.title: FPS Slider
utility.desc: Adds custom sliders to the game that allows you to easily change the games target min and max FPS values.

utility.title: Farm Counter
utility.desc: Adds a customiseable farm counter to keep track of your runs.

utility.title: Grenade Jump Key
utility.desc: Hotkey to throw a default grenade. Temporarily unequips your grenade mod and then automatically reequips it.

utility.title: Grenade Mod Quick Switcher
utility.desc: Adds a keybind that cycles through grenade mods marked as favourite. Cycles in the order that items were added to the backpack, or unequipped.

utility.title: Hide Undiscovered Missions
utility.desc: Hides undiscoved missions in the mission log.

utility.title: Keyboard Change
utility.desc: BL2 and TPS do not handle certain keys (such as Esc and Tab) properly when some keyboard layouts are in use (for example, the Japanese IME). This mod changes the keyboard to English (United States) at start-up so you don’t have to remember to change it yourself every time.

utility.title: Map Reloader
utility.desc: Quickly farm items and save quit at a button press!

utility.title: Mission Selector
utility.desc: Lets you switch through missions with configurable hotkeys like in Borderlands 3.

utility.title: MissionQuickswitcher
utility.desc: Adds two keybinds to the game that allow you to quickly switch between missions without having to open the mission menu.

utility.title: My Favorite Mod
utility.desc: Block dropping starred items in Borderlands 2, TPS, and Attack on Dragon Keep.

utility.title: No Ads
utility.desc: Prevents ads from showing. Includes both the obnoxious banner ads as well as the small MoTD DLC ads.

utility.title: NoCap
utility.desc: Extends team limits and functionality for 5+ player lobbies. Only required on host, clients can join with or without mod installed.

utility.title: Offline Helpers
utility.desc: Adds a few small features useful when playing offline.

utility.title: Open Sanctuary Doors
utility.desc: Automatically opens the doors in Sanctuary, so you don't have to.

utility.title: Photo Mode
utility.desc: Simple Photo Mode. 'Mousewheel Up/Down' to change the active modifier. Hold 'Shift' while scrolling to change the camera movement speed. Hold 'R' while scrolling to change the camera rotation. Hold 'F' while scrolling to change the camera FOV.

utility.title: Ping!
utility.desc: Ping the world! Allows you to ping various objects and locations to communicate with other players. Every player needs to have this mod installed to be able to receive pings.

utility.title: Python Part Notifier
utility.desc: Shows the parts making up all of your items and weapons on their cards. Yes this even includes Grenades, COMs, and Relics/Oz Kits. Has full mod support, so if a mod adds extra parts to a weapon or changes a part’s mesh it will properly update. Unique part support is limited, they may just show the same as the base part with the same mesh.

utility.title: Quick Startup
utility.desc: Instantly jump to the main menu, skips all intro and loading screens. Optionally allows you to immediately load into a character after startup. This can be configured in the mod's options, or via a launch argument: -Character="" -Character="" -Character="" Offline Helpers mod is recommended if using the safe mode option...

utility.title: Quiet Console
utility.desc: Disables most things printed to console by Gearbox, leaving a nice clean console for logging.

utility.title: Respec HotKey (RHK)
utility.desc: Respec skills from anywhere with a hotkey, still costs cash

utility.title: Save File Organizer
utility.desc: Users can name their BL2/TPS files anything they want that ends in the .sav extension. In addition, several utility features are included.

utility.title: Saves Backuper
utility.desc: Back up the contents of your saves folder each time you launch the game. You can set the number of backups that will be kept, to keep them below a certain threshold. You can set which folder to back up and where to back up to.

utility.title: Skill Saver
utility.desc: This mod gives you the ability to save your current skill build, then restore right back to it later. When in game, hit your Manage Skill Layouts bind (Default: F3) Then choose whether or not you want to save your current skill build, then type in your skill build’s name! From here, you can then restore back to that build for your current character class

utility.title: Skill Toggles
utility.desc: Lets you deactivate Action Skills by holding a configurable hotkey.

utility.title: Skill Tree Loadouts
utility.desc: Save and Load skill tree Loadouts to quickly change builds. Access this by clicking the respec button at a New U Station. Builds are saved in json files in the settings folder of the sdk_mods. You can easily share them and install Loadouts there.

utility.title: SniperButton
utility.desc: Automatically modifies ADS speed

utility.title: Super Screenshots
utility.desc: High resolution screenshots independent of game resolution, 1440p - 16k

utility.title: Text Mod Loader
utility.desc: Automatically executes Text Mods stored in binaries.

utility.title: Throw Weapon Then Pickup
utility.desc: Adds a keybind option to the game that allows you to throw your current weapon and then pick up it immediately. The benefit of doing this is: 1.Switch weapon immediately. 2.Reloading magazine immediately. By default the key is binded to H.

utility.title: True Damage Logger
utility.desc: Prints the actual amount of damage you deal to console, bypassing visual damage cap.

utility.title: Unspec Skills
utility.desc: Allows you to right click on skills to remove points from them. Removing points does get restricted by having points further up in the tree meaning you cannot go unlock a later skill and then just remove points from early skills.

utility.title: Weapon Quick Switcher
utility.desc: Adds a keybind option to the game that allows you to switch to the last used weapon quickly. By default the key is binded to Q.

utility.title: modthatclosesthegamewhenitopens
utility.desc: mod that closes the game when it opens

lib.title: BPD Useful Commands
lib.desc: Utility library for BPDs. - Run custom BPD events from python with custom outputs. - Converts VariableData's variable to another type, like a BVAR_Object to a BVAR_Vector using the new convert_bpd_variable command. - Debug a BPD's VariableData using the new log_bpd / log_path_bpd commands on a live object to log...

lib.title: CanvasLIB
lib.desc: A library for easy writing to the screen with different fonts and alignments.

lib.title: Change Util
lib.desc: Simplifies the process of modifying Unreal Engine objects, and tracks changes so that they can be reverted later.

lib.title: Command Extensions
lib.desc: Adds a few new console commands, and provides functionality for other mods to do the same. All these commands are fully compatible with blcmm files, you can just put them in your mod and have users merge it with other files and enable/disable various categories and it all just keeps working fine.

lib.title: Constructor
lib.desc: PythonSDK Mod/Resource that allows the easy creation and use of new non replacing Objects.

lib.title: Enums
lib.desc: Imports all Unrealscript enums into Python.

lib.title: EridiumLib
lib.desc: Holds utility functions for some mods.

lib.title: Live Feed
lib.desc: Provides access to continuously up-to-date information about the current game, for chatbots and other applications.

lib.title: Sanity Saver
lib.desc: Disables sanity check, and also saves items which don’t serialize, which would have parts deleted even with it off.

lib.title: Structs
lib.desc: Imports all Unrealscript structs into Python as named tuples.

lib.title: TPS SkinFix
lib.desc: Allows the exec and set command for MaterialInstanceConstant Objects. This allows the editing of Skins in TPS. Simply place this mod inside your TPS Mods folder, no enabling of this mod needed.

lib.title: UE Timers
lib.desc: Library to add timers using the unreal timer functionality. Huge thanks to RedxYeti for the original information on how to make this work.

lib.title: UserFeedback
lib.desc: Adds several functions/classes to let you show various types of feedback to and get input from your users.

lib.title: blimgui
lib.desc: A library that allows modders to easily create and manage a separate window to develope GUI mods.

lib.title: coroutines
lib.desc: A library that adds simple tick and draw coroutines.

lib.title: maploader
lib.desc: Allows the use of custom map files created by the MapEditor.

lib.title: texloader
lib.desc: Runtime texture loading for Borderlands 2: load arbitrary PNG/JPEG images as real Texture2D objects.

lib.title: tracelib
lib.desc: A library that allows devs to easily trace ingame objects.

lib.title: tweens
lib.desc: A tweening library with various easing functions.

lib.title: uemath
lib.desc: A math library with support for UEVectors and UERotators.

gameplay.title: Ambient Spawns
gameplay.desc: Periodically spawns random groups of enemies. The idea is to make the game more unpredictable.

gameplay.title: Backpack Manager
gameplay.desc: Customize the size of your character’s backpack on the fly!

gameplay.title: Badass Bounties
gameplay.desc: Adds many randomly generated bounties to the game. Each bounty will reward you with XP, Money and a random item upon completion. The rarity of the reward items scale with your level. To open the bounty board menu check your modded keybinds menu.

gameplay.title: Better Boosted Saves
gameplay.desc: Adds a few options for boosted save characters including TVHM/UVHM starts and randomized gear.

gameplay.title: Better Spawns and Better Travel (BSABT)
gameplay.desc: Ports back some qol features of BL3: open the fast travel from anywhere teleport in your vehicle from the map menu spawn at the last triggered spawn station

gameplay.title: Boosted TPS Characters
gameplay.desc: Adds boosted characters to the character select screen. Characters start a the beginning of TVHM. Everyone spawns with the same loot and theres also 2 chests were added to where you wake up.

gameplay.title: Borderlands Rewind
gameplay.desc: Provides options to enable: Weapon merging Weapon skill stacking (e.g. infinite ammo, Evil Smasher buffs) Full amp damage on every pellet

gameplay.title: ComboCounter
gameplay.desc: Kills are now counted towards a killstreak on screen, awarding more XP the higher your kill count goes ! XP multiplication currently capped after 15 kills to prevent ridiculous XP gains

gameplay.title: Difficulty Modes
gameplay.desc: Replaces BAR with a difficulty mode that can be changed in the options.

gameplay.title: Early Skill Points
gameplay.desc: Allow you to set the level at which you start gaining skills point. Additionally, you can set the maximum level where you stop gaining them to offset early skill points gain. Note: skill points are generated when your character spawn, there is no risk of permanently losing them.

gameplay.title: Emotes
gameplay.desc: Adds a list of different emotes. Check Modded Keybinds to configure the mod.

gameplay.title: Enemy and Item Scaling
gameplay.desc: For Borderlands 2 and Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel (the Pre-Sequel side should work but is untested so far). Scales enemies, loot and missions to your level. I wanted to make the gameplay loop somewhat resemble the more modern Borderlands entries. Each bound is its own setting: raise under-levelled enemies, loot or...

gameplay.title: Exp Adjuster
gameplay.desc: Adds sliders to adjust XP amounts: baserates for each mode, as well as multipliers based on level difference from killed enemies.

gameplay.title: Game Scaler
gameplay.desc: Scales all zones in Normal Mode and True Vault Hunter Mode to your level, and removes the level cap for TVHM scaling in BL2 and TPS. In BL2 and TPS, Normal Mode level cap is 35, TVHM minimum level is 30. In AoDK, Normal Mode level cap is 18 and TVHM minimum level is 17.

gameplay.title: Lengyu Copy Device
gameplay.desc: Allows you to spend money to copy the selected equipment. Press the keybind ‘UseSecondary’ on the Equipment page or Backpack page to throw and copy the selected equipment. It costs the selling price of the equipment. It works in multiplayer game when both the server player and the client player have enabled this mod.

gameplay.title: Lilith Patch
gameplay.desc: Modifies the action skill of 55tumbl’s excellent Lilith mod to work more like BL1 Lilith’s Phasewalk. You no longer need a target in the crosshairs.

gameplay.title: Map Reloader
gameplay.desc: Quickly farm items and save quit at a button press!

gameplay.title: Mario Mode
gameplay.desc: Jump on enemies to kill them.

gameplay.title: Melee Enhancement
gameplay.desc: A few tweaks to Zer0 and Krieg to enhance their melee gameplay

gameplay.title: NPCRevives
gameplay.desc: Friendly NPCs will attempt to revive you.

gameplay.title: NoCap
gameplay.desc: Extends team limits and functionality for 5+ player lobbies. Only required on host, clients can join with or without mod installed.

gameplay.title: One-Hit KO
gameplay.desc: Makes you die in one hit.

gameplay.title: Open Sesame
gameplay.desc: Make containers open automatically when damaged.

gameplay.title: Optional Objectives Rewards
gameplay.desc: Automatically rewards ALL optional objectives in Borderlands 2 and The Pre-Sequel with configurable rewards that scale by playthrough difficulty.

gameplay.title: Pay To Loot
gameplay.desc: Picking up ground loot is no longer free. They now cost as much as they would in a vendor.

gameplay.title: Reign Of Giants
gameplay.desc: It’s a concept we all know and love: Rare enemy variants, like Loot Midgets and Tubbies. Reign Of Giants extends this to every enemy in the game.

gameplay.title: Revive Time Modifier
gameplay.desc: Using the scroller in the options, choose your time in seconds for how long it takes to revive teammates. The options range from 0 to 10 seconds in 0.5 second increments.

gameplay.title: ScaledTVHM
gameplay.desc: Fixes the TVHM scaling for TTAoDK One Shot Adventure. Now everything will scale with the player level in TVHM.

gameplay.title: Scaling Adjuster
gameplay.desc: Adds an option to let you easily adjust the game's base scaling constant.

gameplay.title: Spare Parts
gameplay.desc: Allows you to salvage parts from items and attach them to other items. Just select an item from your backpack, hover over another item and press the ‘salvage’ hotkey. Default is [C] Note: the item you salvage parts from will be destroyed in the process.

gameplay.title: Spawn Multiplier
gameplay.desc: Adds an option to let you easily multiply the amount of spawns you’re getting, updating live.

gameplay.title: Speedrun Practice
gameplay.desc: Borderlands 2 mod with various utilities to help in practicing speedruns. All speedruns are currently supported on some level, although many runs (e.g. current patch) don’t need much help other than an easy way to make practice saves.

gameplay.title: Trivia
gameplay.desc: Trivia minigame for BL2, With easy and hard difficulties. Requires MapLoader and UserFeedback

gameplay.title: Ultimate Scavenger Mod
gameplay.desc: This mod automaically equips items when they spawn as long as your character can equip them, showing a message when it’s equipped. Excluded examples are items higher level than your character or classmods not for your character. Options include: Font Size sliders for the messages, more informative messages and a few gunzerker options. If you plan on playing gunzerker, make sure to check the known issues on github. Single player only. Nexus Mods: https://www.nexusmods.com/borderlands2/mods/412

gameplay.title: Weapon Proficiencies
gameplay.desc: This mod ports weapon proficiencies from Borderlands 1 without any changes.

dialog.title: Audio Control
dialog.desc: Stop certain sounds from playing, more sounds can be added in the future

dialog.title: Dialog Randomizer
dialog.desc: If it talks, it gets randomized. DLC dialogs are only loaded while in the DLC, therefore they can only be played/randomized inside the DLC.

dialog.title: HitSounds
dialog.desc: Plays a sound on hit. Spawns confetti on critical hit.

dialog.title: Less DOT Screams
dialog.desc: Options to disable DOT (status effect) screams, or only to play when shield is broken.

dialog.title: LootNotificator
dialog.desc: Plays special Particles and sounds depending on the loot rarity. Supports Reborn and Exodus (non SDK version).

vehicle.title: Afterburn Tweaks
vehicle.desc: Using this mod you can change: Minimum start speed for afterburner Afterburn speed Afterburn duration Afterburn regen rate Afterburn regen delay For the runner, technical and hovercraft. I mostly made this so I could afterburn right away like borderlands 1.

vehicle.title: Alt Use Catch-a-Ride
vehicle.desc: Adds alt use binds to Catch-a-Ride stations, to instantly deploy a vehicle. Options to teleport to vehicle on spawn, choose a vehicle family (including DLC vehicles), and choose the vehicle weapon to use for each family.

vehicle.title: Always Teleport Vehicles
vehicle.desc: Choose whether to always teleport into and-or out of vehicles.

vehicle.title: FirstPersonDriver
vehicle.desc: Drive the Vehicles from first person perspective. Adds a keybind to toggle between 1st and 3rd person. You can change the keybinds in Modded Keybinds menu.

vehicle.title: Insta Vehicles
vehicle.desc: Allows you to instantly spawn a vehicle like bl4. Only works in maps where vehicles are supported and based on mission progress. Vehicle customisation is still handled through the vehicle station. Slot 1 is used for spawning vehicles and selecting the customisation.

cheat.title: Apple's Borderlands Cheats
cheat.desc: Adds keybinds performing various cheaty things.

cheat.title: BalanceDropper
cheat.desc: Drop loot from any Item and ItemPool directly at your feet via a searchable blimgui UI. Also requires modder_commands not in the db

cheat.title: Commander
cheat.desc: A PythonSDK mod for Borderlands series games that provides useful functionality while in-game: * Saving and teleporting your position in the world * Modifying game speed * Configuring your own hotkeys to run console commands of your choice, such as: * Toggling the HUD * Toggling Third Person * Quitting...

cheat.title: Lengyu TP Device
cheat.desc: Allows you to teleport yourself anywhere you marked. 1.Press NUMPad0 to mark the location. 2.Press NUMPadDot to teleport. 3.Press NUMPad1-3 to switch within 3 slots. 4.Press NUMPad4-6 to teleport other player to you. 5.Open the option to print teleport console command when you mark location. It works in mutiplayer games. It doesn’t work in the map Digistruct Peak.

cheat.title: Limitless
cheat.desc: You can customize how many points can go into skills, and how many skill points you gain per level. The increased points going into skills also applies to Class Mods. The settings are applied when you save quit and go back in game. The possibilities are almost limitless

dev.title: AkEvent Player
dev.desc: Mostly a dev tool to easily find and play ingame AkEvents.

dev.title: BLSearchTool
dev.desc: Runtime UObject/UFunction browser with hook testing - works across BL1, BL2, BL3, WL, and BL4.

dev.title: BPD Useful Commands
dev.desc: Utility library for BPDs. - Run custom BPD events from python with custom outputs. - Converts VariableData's variable to another type, like a BVAR_Object to a BVAR_Vector using the new convert_bpd_variable command. - Debug a BPD's VariableData using the new log_bpd / log_path_bpd commands on a live object to log...

dev.title: BalanceDropper
dev.desc: Drop loot from any Item and ItemPool directly at your feet via a searchable blimgui UI. Also requires modder_commands not in the db

dev.title: Bl2ModCabinet
dev.desc: **Mod Cabinet** adds an in-game “cabinet” style menu for Borderlands 2 SDK mods.

dev.title: Collision Visualizer
dev.desc: Visualizes invisible blocking/killing collision volumes and allows hiding meshes with no collision.

dev.title: Command Extensions
dev.desc: Adds a few new console commands, and provides functionality for other mods to do the same. All these commands are fully compatible with blcmm files, you can just put them in your mod and have users merge it with other files and enable/disable various categories and it all just keeps working fine.

dev.title: Console Font Size
dev.desc: Gives a slider in the mod settings to adjust the console font size.

dev.title: Constructor
dev.desc: PythonSDK Mod/Resource that allows the easy creation and use of new non replacing Objects.

dev.title: Custom Skins
dev.desc: A simple mod allowing you to have custom character skins, all selectable! Hit R in the mod menu to reload your skins Press O to open your skin folder Toggle skins in the Options menu, sorted by character

dev.title: Decent Console
dev.desc: My attempt at improving the ingame console by adding: - ctrl+backspace to delete the last word - ctrl+delete to delete the next word - ctrl+left/right to move the cursor by word - auto-completion for commands by pressing tab - switch between suggestions or history with up/down - suggestions will show...

dev.title: Find Actors
dev.desc: Small library for finding actors near the player or other objects.

dev.title: Live Feed
dev.desc: Provides access to continuously up-to-date information about the current game, for chatbots and other applications.

dev.title: Material Editor
dev.desc: Allows you to edit MaterialInstanceConstant Objects in realtime.

dev.title: Object Relocator
dev.desc: Tool to help with map editing. Pickup, move and rotate a static map object, then release it to log its infos to a file in the mod folder. The log contain the object's new location and rotation values. Allow blcm hotfixes to modify StaticMeshCollectionActor's StaticMeshComponents / StaticMeshActor / Handplaced WillowInteractiveObject...

dev.title: Package Loader
dev.desc: A library for the Borderlands SDK that allows multiple mods to load large numbers of packages in an efficient and user-friendly way.

dev.title: Quiet Console
dev.desc: Disables most things printed to console by Gearbox, leaving a nice clean console for logging.

dev.title: TPS SkinFix
dev.desc: Allows the exec and set command for MaterialInstanceConstant Objects. This allows the editing of Skins in TPS. Simply place this mod inside your TPS Mods folder, no enabling of this mod needed.

dev.title: True Damage Logger
dev.desc: Prints the actual amount of damage you deal to console, bypassing visual damage cap.

dev.title: Visual Triggers
dev.desc: Provides keybinds for outlining waypoints and triggers with skeleton debug cylinders.

dev.title: Weapon Debug
dev.desc: Adds on-screen real-time weapon statistics and/or part attributes displays.

dev.title: texloader
dev.desc: Runtime texture loading for Borderlands 2: load arbitrary PNG/JPEG images as real Texture2D objects.
